shows.title: Breaking Bad
shows.description: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer turns to manufacturing and selling methamphetamine with a former student to secure his family's future.

shows.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
shows.description: After a century frozen in ice, young Avatar Aang journeys with friends to master the four elements and bring balance to a world at war with the Fire Nation.

shows.title: Game of Thrones
shows.description: Nine noble families vie for control of Westeros and the Iron Throne, while an ancient threat beyond The Wall begins to stir.

shows.title: Attack on Titan
shows.description: In a world where humanity shelters behind towering walls from man-eating Titans, a determined teen joins the elite Survey Corps to fight the giants and uncover the secrets of their origin.

shows.title: The Dark Knight
shows.description: When a menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman, James Gordon and Harvey Dent must work together to put an end to the madness.

shows.title: One Piece
shows.description: A spirited young pirate sets sail with a growing crew in search of the legendary One Piece, facing dangerous seas and powerful rivals on his quest to become King of the Pirates.

shows.title: Cowboy Bebop
shows.description: Intergalactic loners team up to track down fugitives and turn them in for cold hard cash.

shows.title: Inception
shows.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

shows.title: Succession
shows.description: The Roy family is known for controlling the biggest media and entertainment company in the world. However, their world changes when their father steps down from the company.

shows.title: Interstellar
shows.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

shows.title: Shogun
shows.description: When a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby Japanese fishing village, Lord Yoshii Toranaga discovers secrets that could tip the scales of power and devastate his enemies.

shows.title: One Punch Man
shows.description: Saitama, a superhero who can defeat any foe with a single punch, battles boredom as he searches for a worthy opponent in a world plagued by monsters.

shows.title: Spirited Away
shows.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

shows.title: Stranger Things
shows.description: In 1980s Indiana, a group of young friends witness supernatural forces and secret government exploits. As they search for answers, the children unravel a series of extraordinary mysteries.

shows.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
shows.description: After swallowing a cursed relic, kindhearted teenager Yuji Itadori becomes host to the King of Curses and joins a secret school of sorcerers battling monsters born from humanity's darkest emotions.

shows.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
shows.description: A family is attacked by demons and only two members survive - Tanjiro and his sister Nezuko, who is turning into a demon slowly. Tanjiro sets out to become a demon slayer to avenge his family and cure his sister.

shows.title: Vikings
shows.description: Vikings transports us to the brutal and mysterious world of Ragnar Lothbrok, a Viking warrior and farmer who yearns to explore--and raid--the distant shores across the ocean.

shows.title: Parasite
shows.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

shows.title: Dune: Part Two
shows.description: Paul Atreides unites with the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future.

shows.title: The Last of Us
shows.description: After a global pandemic destroys civilization, a hardened survivor takes charge of a 14-year-old girl who may be humanity's last hope.

shows.title: House of the Dragon
shows.description: An internal succession war within House Targaryen at the height of its power, 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen.

shows.title: Top Gun: Maverick
shows.description: The story involves Maverick confronting his past while training a group of younger Top Gun graduates, including the son of his deceased best friend, for a dangerous mission.

shows.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Movie: Mugen Train
shows.description: After his family was brutally murdered and his sister turned into a demon, Tanjiro Kamado's journey as a demon slayer began. Tanjiro and his comrades embark on a new mission aboard the Mugen Train, on track to despair.

shows.title: Oppenheimer
shows.description: A dramatization of the life story of J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who had a large hand in the development of the atomic bombs that brought an end to World War II.

shows.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
shows.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.
